[SWS_EthSwt_00514] Behaviour if EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to
IVL and VLAN-ID is set to 0
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00087
⌈If EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to IVL and given VLAN-ID is set to
0, then the EthSwt driver shall consider the given the MAC-address to determine the
MAC-address to Ethernet port assignment irrespective of the VLAN.⌋
